item.title: Thank You for Serving Members Through the Outage
item.description: Thanks for continuing to serve our Members on Friday 13 November as we worked through the Microsoft outage. Teams adapted well to make sure we were here for members.

item.title: ACC Conference: LeavePlus Legal in Sydney

item.title: Cricket: England Level ODI Series - Hobart Decider Wed 18 Nov
item.description: England won in Adelaide on Sunday 15 November after Australia took the Perth opener by seven wickets. A Tom Banton century and four wickets from Gus Atkinson made the difference.
